India's Anti-Terrorism Agency Charges LeT Founder Over Kashmir Attack

The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has named LeT chief Hafiz Saeed as an accused in a supplementary chargesheet related to the Pahalgam terror attack that killed 25 tourists and a local civilian last year. The NIA alleges that the attack was planned and monitored, and Hafiz Saeed is believed to have been involved in the planning and execution of the attack.
